_about: Hand-written descriptions of individual houses, read from street-level photos (tools/facade-views.mjs → data/raw/views/house-<code>_<edge>.jpg). Keyed by RÚIAN building code. Colours are sRGB. ground: shops | restaurant | windows | gate | blank. rustic: none | banded | ornate. edges: per-facade extras by footprint edge index (awning, banner, lanterns). signs: false keeps the OpenStreetMap shop signs off (only what the photos show).
